title: A Better Tomorrow III
description: Cheung meets a beautiful gang-leader while trying to bring his family from wartime Saigon to Hong Kong.

title: Standing Up, Falling Down
description: A failing stand-up comedian and an alcoholic dermatologist give each other the confidence to face the failures in their lives.

title: Villains
description: Amateur criminals stumble upon a dark secret in a sadistic couple's home.

title: Agent Red
description: A Marine commander (Dolph Lundgren) accompanies a submarine carrying a chemical virus to a secure storage facility.

title: Bright Young Things
description: After losing the manuscript of his first novel, a penniless writer (Stephen Campbell Moore) must raise enough money to marry his superficial girlfriend (Emily Mortimer).

title: The Bodyguard
description: Kiba is back again, but this time he has fallen from grace and been sent to prison for all the violent acts he has committed. Once he's out, he begins working as a bodyguard in a club that is crawling with gangsters.

title: All I See Is You
description: In Bangkok, a young blind woman undergoes a cutting-edge operation that restores sight to her right eye. Able to see again, she slowly starts to realize that her newfound independence makes her husband feel jealous, threatened and insecure.

title: Silver City
description: A campaign manager hires a private detective (Danny Huston) after a Colorado gubernatorial candidate finds a dead body while fishing.

title: City on Fire
description: An undercover cop (Chow Yun-Fat) infiltrates a gang of jewel thieves, but things go terribly wrong during a heist.

title: Capricorn One
description: The first manned flight to Mars is a flop, so a space official (Hal Holbrook) fakes it Hollywood-style for the public.

title: To Kill With Intrigue
description: The Honeybee Flower gang kills everyone in Lei mansion but Siao Lei, spared by their leader because she likes him.

title: Escape to Athena
description: A Greek partisan (Telly Savalas) helps Allied prisoners escape with ancient art from a German major's (Roger Moore) island prison.

title: Candy
description: A fatherly chemistry professor indulges two young lovers in their ever-increasing heroin habits as his life spins out of control.

title: Joe Strummer: The Future Is Unwritten
description: Martin Scorsese, Bono, Jim Jarmusch, Flea and others recall the life of Joe Strummer, singer and guitarist for the Clash.

title: Suburbia
description: An overwhelming sense of despair impels a teenager to leave his suburban home and join up with a group of punk rockers.

title: The Decline of Western Civilization Part III
description: Filmmaker Penelope Spheeris examines the lives of young punk fans who live homeless on the streets of Los Angeles.

title: Sea Fever
description: A marine biology student and other crew members fight for survival when an unfathomable life-form attacks their fishing trawler.

title: Security
description: A mall security guard has to protect a female witness from a gang after they lose all forms of communication during a storm.

title: A Walk to Remember
description: Forced to tutor students at a school, a young delinquent (Shane West) falls for a minister's (Peter Coyote) daughter (Mandy Moore).

title: On Golden Pond
description: An old professor (Henry Fonda) and his wife (Katharine Hepburn) make peace with their daughter (Jane Fonda) in New England.

title: Magic
description: A neurotic ventriloquist's belief that his stage dummy controls his actions leads him to murder, madness and more.

title: Fever Pitch
description: A teacher (Colin Firth), obsessed with soccer and a team that hasn't won a league cup in 18 years, begins a shaky relationship.

title: Insomnia
description: A yuppie (Cristina Marcos) befriends a real estate agent (Ernesto Alterio) engaged to a woman who shops compulsively.

title: Squadron 303: The Battle of Britain
description: Polish fighter pilots defend the United Kingdom during the Battle of Britain.

title: Today You Die
description: A world-class thief (Steven Seagal) escapes from prison to exact revenge on the partners who doubled-crossed him.

title: The Rookies
description: An extreme sports athlete joins a mysterious special agent and her ragtag team of recruits to battle a group of deadly terrorists.

title: Black Christmas
description: Sorority sisters (Olivia Hussey, Margot Kidder) and their drunken housemother fall prey to an obscene yuletide caller.

title: Buena Vista Social Club
description: Filmmaker Wim Wenders shows a number of renowned Cuban musicians of all ages who gathered to create a Grammy-winning album.

title: Honest Thief
description: Hoping to cut a deal, a professional bank robber agrees to return all the money he stole in exchange for a reduced sentence. But when two FBI agents set him up for murder, he must now go on the run to clear his name and bring them to justice.

title: I'm Charlie Walker
description: Trucking and construction entrepreneur Charlie Walker fights institutional racism while cleaning up a massive oil spill off the coast of San Francisco in 1971.

title: Rolling Kansas
description: Three brothers, a gas-station attendant and a narcoleptic nurse embark on a road trip to find a marijuana forest.

title: My Best Fiend
description: Filmmaker Werner Herzog narrates an exploration of his love-hate relationship with actor Klaus Kinski.

title: Elvira's Haunted Hills
description: In the 19th century, a buxom woman (Cassandra Peterson) of mystery and shtick visits a castle inhabited by a fatally cursed family.

title: Communion
description: A novelist's (Christopher Walken) wife (Lindsay Crouse) and son (Joel Carlson) see him changed by an apparent encounter with aliens in the mountains.

title: The Last Seduction
description: An insurance executive (Linda Fiorentino) skips town with drug money and stops at nothing to get what she wants.

title: Dog Soldiers
description: A pack of werewolves targets a squad of soldiers (Sean Pertwee, Kevin McKidd) on a training exercise in the Scottish Highlands.

title: Movie Movie
description: Old-movie parodies: "Dynamite Hands," about a boxing law student (Harry Hamlin) ; "Baxter's Beauties of 1933," about a producer's (George C. Scott) show.

title: Red Riding: 1983
description: The disappearance of a young girl leads a Yorkshire detective (David Morrissey) to believe that he may have helped convict the wrong man of murder three years earlier.

title: Steamboat Bill, Jr.
description: A young college student tries to impress his girlfriend while trying to meet the expectations of his father; he is asked to man his girlfriend's father's vessel but doesn't know his bow from his elbow.

title: Clockwatchers
description: Friendship helps make nightmarish office jobs bearable for four young women working as temporary employees.

title: Silent Hill: Revelation
description: When her adoptive father disappears, Sharon Da Silva is drawn into a strange and terrifying alternate reality that holds answers to the horrific nightmares that have plagued her since childhood.

title: Whale Rider
description: A Maori girl (Keisha Castle-Hughes) defies her grandfather (Rawiri Paratene) and 1,000 years of tradition to prove she can lead their tribe.

title: Bullet in the Head
description: Three Hong Kong gang fighters (Tony Leung Chiu Wai, Jacky Cheung, Waise Lee) try crime in Vietnam and land in a prison camp with U.S. soldiers.
